card.name: Colon before revision or build dates
card.fires_on: Punctuation (colon or bar) right after labels like "Last Revised" or "Build date" in web page footers, just before a date. Also weaker on separators in page metadata.

modes.label: Revision date label
modes.description: The colon or bar after "Last Revised" in Healthwise-style patient pages, before the date.
modes.example: Reference Healthwise Staff||Last Revised<<:>> Reference August 3, 20

modes.label: Build date label
modes.description: The colon after "Build date" in software documentation, before a numeric date.

modes.label: Other page metadata
modes.description: Dashes, ordinals or bars in page headers and citations.
modes.example: Rosen’s Emergency Medicine: Concepts and Clinical Practice. 7<<th>> ed. Philadelphia, Pa: Mosby

card.plain: It fires on the punctuation after a "Last Revised" or "Build date" label, just before the date appears.
